title: Sweet Jasmine Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sweet Jasmine- renovated beach home in Seaside sleeping 10 w/ new kitchen, bathroom updates, and more! A prime location on a large corner lot with a private driveway, great outdoor spaces, one block to the beach and downtown Seaside. Tower w/ gulf views!
description_expanded: Description78 East Ruskin Street1 KING, 3 QUEENS, 2 TWIN BEDS (sleeps 10) Fully Renovated Seaside Beach RetreatSweet Jasmine is a beautifully fully renovated Seaside home, offering modern coastal comfort in one of the most desirable locations in Seaside, Florida. Recent top-to-bottom updates include a completely renovated kitchen with all-new appliances, custom cabinetry, updated countertops, and fully renovated bathrooms throughout. A newly added ensuite bathroom downstairs and a reimagined bonus tower now accessible via an interior spiral staircase further elevate this exceptional beach retreat.Prime Corner-Lot Location Near Beach & Town CenterSituated on a large corner lot in the first block from the beach, Sweet Jasmine boasts an unbeatable location just one block from Seaside Central Square. Guests are within walking distance of over 35 shops and restaurants, while enjoying the convenience of a large private driveway with parking for two vehicles—a rare luxury in Seaside.Private Outdoor Living SpacesUpon arrival, guests are welcomed by a fenced front yard and a charming Adirondack seating area with space for five, complete with a tranquil fountain just steps from the front door. Multiple outdoor living areas throughout the home provide plenty of room to relax, unwind, and enjoy Seaside’s laid-back coastal lifestyle.First-Floor Bedrooms with Ensuite BathsThe first level features four thoughtfully designed bedrooms, offering privacy and comfort for families and groups.The king bedroom includes a mounted flat-screen TV, a private ensuite bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower, and access to an open-air porch with a bed swing—perfect for afternoon reading or morning coffee.A queen bedroom features its own private ensuite bath with a walk-in shower and single vanity.The third bedroom offers a queen bed with access to a beautifully updated hall bathroom with a tub and shower combination.The fourth bedroom includes a queen bed and private ensuite bathroom, creating an ideal guest suite.Open-Concept Living with Renovated KitchenUpstairs, vaulted ceilings frame an inviting open-concept living area designed for gathering. The fully renovated kitchen features all-new appliances, updated countertops, and custom built-in cabinetry, seamlessly connecting to the dining area with seating for five. A kids’ dining table adds a thoughtful touch for family-friendly meals.The living space offers comfortable slipcovered seating and a flat-screen TV, making it the perfect place to relax after a day at the beach. Just off the living area, a large private balcony features a bench swing and outdoor dining for four—ideal for sunset dinners and coastal evenings.A butler’s pantry and laundry room are conveniently located off the kitchen and lead to a half bath.Bonus Tower with Twin BedsA new interior spiral staircase leads to the enclosed bonus tower room, now thoughtfully designed with two twin beds and a half bath. This unique space offers a peaceful retreat to enjoy fresh coastal air, birdsong, and treetop views—perfect for kids, teens, or extra guests.Your Ideal Seaside EscapeWith its prime location, spacious layout, and completed renovations throughout, Sweet Jasmine is a standout vacation home in Seaside, Florida. Just steps from the beach and moments from town, this charming cottage offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and walkable convenience—an ideal setting for your next unforgettable Seaside getaway.FEATURESFeatures: 1,966 square feetPrivate Seaside Residential Beach: East Ruskin PavilionWalk to Beach Access: 2-minute, 413-foot walkCommunity Amenities: Access to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote: Includes 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityGuest Services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking: 2 parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car, and golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitPets: No pets allowedSTR23-002097
